tiers.core: Must understand before approving: new or changed data models, schemas, or migrations; auth, permissions, or other security-sensitive paths; public API or interface contracts; core business logic added, rewritten, or removed; new external services or dependencies; changes to how data is stored, sent, or deleted.
tiers.notable: Worth a read: new modules, components, or functions; non-trivial logic changes; cross-cutting refactors; new configuration or feature flags; error handling, retries, or state management.
tiers.minor: Skim: renames, moved code, formatting, simple wiring, tests that mirror the code, copy changes, boilerplate.
